parameters.query: INSERT INTO report_snapshots (snapshot_date, metric, scope, value) VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, 'total_revenue', 'company', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'Won')) ON CONFLICT (snapshot_date, metric, scope) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value; INSERT INTO report_snapshots (snapshot_date, metric, scope, value) VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, 'new_contacts', 'company', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE)) ON CONFLICT (snapshot_date, metric, scope) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value; INSERT INTO report_snapshots (snapshot_date, metric, scope, value) VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, 'activity_volume', 'company', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE)) ON CONFLICT (snapshot_date, metric, scope) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value;

nodes.name: Postgres: Write Daily Snapshots
nodes.notes: Writes/updates 3 metrics for today's date: total_revenue (all-time cumulative, snapshotted daily so the Overview trend line is stable even as raw opportunity rows change), new_contacts (count created today), activity_volume (count created today). Add more INSERT...ON CONFLICT blocks here following the same pattern if you want more tracked metrics later (e.g. per-rep revenue snapshots using scope = user_id::text instead of 'company').
